$comment: The pinned continuo build rondo drives (DECISIONS.md D-0017 rule 4, moved by D-0021 and moved again to take continuo D-1110; D-0017's own open questions say that moving the pin is this edit and a green matrix, not a new decision). CI provisions exactly this revision; src/continuo/pin.ts mirrors these three values as literals so that no module under src/ needs a filesystem capability, and test/continuo/pin.test.ts fails if the two ever drift. Moving the pin is an edit to this file, to that module and to the recorded version line together.
